newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
A total of 33,400 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 32,300 formulated and 1,100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Confirmed: None Week Ago: None Year Ago: None
Wk to Date: 33,400 Week Ago: 49,900 Year Ago: 36,400
The last established price was 64.00 on Thursday. Today's packer bids are 64.00 with asking prices 66.00-68.00. Note all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
